CFB-week.summary: College lines were thin: ESPN's feed has no CFB props this week and most odds pages render by script, so 11 lines from named books (ProphetX, theScore Bet, bet365) were collected. Main news: Ohio State is without QB Julian Sayin (Fahey or St. Clair to start at USC), Iowa loses RB Kamari Moulton for the season and starts Hank Brown at QB, and Arizona's Noah Fifita is healthy for Texas Tech.

NBA-OKC-at-HOU-1101.summary: OKC arrives badly short-handed (Jalen Williams, Wallace, Holmgren, Caruso, Topic, Sorber all out), putting more on Gilgeous-Alexander, Mitchell, McCain and Hartenstein. Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back after its first loss, with Sengun and Sheppard (both back) having sat Friday and Adams out; Houston's Saturday report was not yet filed.

NBA-POR-at-UTAH-1031.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant (Grade 2 hamstring, about four weeks) and Shaedon Sharpe; backup center Robert Williams III is questionable with a knee issue. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, and Lauri Markkanen is questionable with a right wrist sprain; if he sits, Keyonte George and Darryn Peterson carry the scoring load.

NFL-ARI-at-DAL-1101.summary: Dallas enters off a 38-21 win over Philadelphia in which Javonte Williams ran 25 times for 155 yards and a score. George Pickens is questionable (shoulder/hamstring) after two limited practices, and Arizona plays without starting guard Jon Gaines and DT Walter Nolen with center Hjalte Froholdt questionable.

NFL-ATL-at-TB-1101.summary: Tampa Bay ruled out WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) and has RT Luke Goedeke questionable after two missed practices; Bucky Irving and Chris Godwin had rest days and were full Friday. Atlanta ruled out RB Brian Robinson (hamstring, DNP all week), leaving Bijan Robinson with Khalil Herbert as the only other back; WR Olamide Zaccheaus is questionable after limited practices all week.

NFL-CHI-at-SEA-1103.summary: Chicago's Kyle Monangai has not practiced (thumb, toe) and looks likely to miss a fourth straight game, keeping D'Andre Swift as lead back; TE Colston Loveland was added Friday as limited with a neck injury, with Kmet already on season-ending IR. Seattle has LT Charles Cross (high ankle) and WR Rashid Shaheed missing both practices, RB Zach Charbonnet dipped to limited Friday, and several linebackers (Nwosu, O'Connell) did not practice.

NFL-CLE-at-PIT-1101.summary: Rico Dowdle practiced fully Thursday coming back from a toe injury, but Mike McCarthy said Jaylen Warren's role will not change. Pittsburgh is thin at receiver (Pittman on IR, Wilson and Skowronek out per the beat report), which may push more work to the tight ends; Pittsburgh is also without corners Slaughter and Echols.

NFL-IND-at-JAX-1101.summary: Steichen is sticking with Daniel Jones (4 TD, 7 INT in seven games post-Achilles) for a 2-5 Colts team that is a 10-point underdog; Warren is cleared, Gould and CB Walley are out, TE Ogletree questionable. Jacksonville comes off a bye in its first home game in 34 days, but WR2 Jakobi Meyers missed Friday practice and is questionable.

NFL-LV-at-NYJ-1101.summary: Cousins stays the Raiders' starter and Bowers practiced fully Thursday and Friday with no designation; guard Powers-Johnson is questionable after a DNP and limited session. The Jets' pass rush is depleted (Ossai, Sweat out, Bailey doubtful) and Breece Hall is questionable after limited practices all week, which clouds Braelon Allen's workload.

NFL-NE-at-MIA-1101.summary: A.J. Brown's practice trend went backward (limited, then two DNPs) and TreVeyon Henderson missed Thursday and Friday with an illness; both are questionable. Malik Willis practiced fully all week despite a groin listing, while Miami is without OT Kadyn Proctor (concussion). De'Von Achane does not appear in Miami's lineup or injury report after a September knee injury.

NFL-PHI-at-WAS-1102.summary: Tanner McKee starts again with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve (blood clot), and the Eagles are without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, plus RB Dameon Pierce (IR). Saquon Barkley missed two practices before a limited Friday but is set to play. Washington is missing DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw, has Terry McLaurin on IR, and TE John Bates and WR Treylon Burks did not practice.

NFL-TEN-at-CIN-1101.summary: Tennessee is without leading receiver Carnell Tate (shoulder) and RB Tyjae Spears (knee); Calvin Ridley (hip) is questionable after limited Wednesday and Thursday sessions. That pushes volume to Wan'Dale Robinson, Elic Ayomanor and Tony Pollard. Cincinnati is missing S Kyle Dugger; Ja'Marr Chase's midweek DNP was a rest day and he practiced fully Thursday.

SOCCER-day.summary: Little current team news surfaced for most fixtures. Bournemouth are without midfielder Alex Scott (about two months out since early October) and Arsenal have Saka listed out plus Rice, Madueke and Calafiori doubtful, so both -1.5 bets get a caution. Lankshear is predicted to lead the Middlesbrough line.

fix.summary: Quality-gate checks on Top-list picks without notes: Lamar Jackson returns for Baltimore at Buffalo; Tennessee is without WR Carnell Tate and RB Tyjae Spears; Colts have Alec Pierce on IR and TE Tyler Warren questionable; the other checked players are off their final injury reports.

NBA-LAL-at-GS-1031.summary: Luka Doncic is off the Lakers injury report after resting a back issue, and Ziaire Williams (left foot/heel) is questionable pending a pregame check. Golden State remains without Porzingis, Butler and Moody, with Gui Santos (knee) day-to-day.

NFL-BAL-at-BUF-1101.summary: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday and is trending toward returning after missing three games, during which Baltimore went 1-2 and was shut out after halftime in its last two losses. Buffalo comes off a bye with DJ Moore (shoulder) and Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited, RT Spencer Brown (back) out of practice both days, and backup RB Ray Davis sick Thursday.

NFL-KC-at-DEN-1101.summary: Kansas City's pass catchers are uncertain: Travis Kelce (ankle) went from full Wednesday to limited Thursday and Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited again. Patrick Mahomes (knee) practiced fully both days. Kenneth Walker's receptions line has fallen from 3.5 to 2.5 with no explaining news found. Denver WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) and RB RJ Harvey (knee) were limited.

NFL-MIN-at-DET-1101.summary: Minnesota RB Aaron Jones (knee) missed Wednesday and was limited Thursday, and is day-to-day; Jordan Mason led the backfield with 15 carries in Week 7. Backup TE Gavin Bartholomew (ankle) was added to the report Thursday and did not practice. Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown practiced fully Thursday; S Kerby Joseph and CB Ennis Rakestraw were limited both days.
